sentences.en: Questioned about his policies, the candidate gave only vague answers.
sentences.zh: 在被问及他的政策时，这位候选人只给出了模糊的回答。

sentences.en: I deal in facts and figures, not vague impressions.
sentences.zh: 我从事的是事实和数据的工作，而不是含糊的印象。

sentences.en: He seemed vague about what he wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 他对自己的打算似乎模棱两可。
